notes: BBOFSA (Business Brokers of San Antonio) uses an Elementor-based WordPress site. Listings displayed in article.elementor-post containers. Prices are not displayed on listing cards (confidential listings). Some sold listings include prices in their titles. The site uses a standard WordPress posts loop. URLs for individual listings would need to be extracted via href attributes (requires browser automation). 6 listings found on the main page. Many are marked as SOLD.
